items.title: Nasa launches powerful new space telescope to explore mysteries of the Universe
items.summary: The US space agency's telescope is starting a multi-year mission to create a new map of the universe and learn more about dark energy and dark matter.
items.titleZh: 美国国家航空航天局发射强大的新型太空望远镜，探索宇宙的奥秘
items.summaryZh: 美国航天局的望远镜正在开始一项为期多年的任务，以绘制新的宇宙地图，并了解更多关于暗能量和暗物质的信息。

items.title: Caterpillar is bringing to AI deployment what it learned from automating mining
items.summary: Caterpillar has spent decades putting autonomous machines to work at remote mining sites. It's now bringing that experience to AI deployment.
items.titleZh: 卡特彼勒将从自动化采矿中学到的知识引入人工智能部署
items.summaryZh: 卡特彼勒花费了数十年的时间，将自动驾驶机器投入到偏远的矿场。现在，它正在将这种体验带到人工智能部署中。

items.title: Six months into the Iran war, the global economy has pulled off a ‘Mission Impossible’ scene, and the Trump family is among the winners
items.summary: The direst predictions haven’t come true even if no corner of the world's economy has been untouched.
items.titleZh: 伊朗战争爆发六个月后，全球经济出现了“不可能的任务”局面，特朗普家族是赢家之一
items.summaryZh: 即使世界经济的任何一个角落都没有受到影响，最可怕的预测也没有实现。

items.title: Top economist says it’s ‘panic season’ in markets and it’s your fault for taking summer vacation. Blame the ‘harvest time’ mentality
items.summary: Owen Lamont, SVP at $195 billion fund Acadian, says you need to mentally prepare for an "epic financial disaster"—just like every August and September.
items.titleZh: 顶级经济学家表示，现在是市场的“恐慌季节”，休暑假是你的错。归咎于“收获时间”的心态
items.summaryZh: 1950亿美元基金Acadian的高级副总裁Owen Lamont表示，你需要为“史诗般的金融灾难”做好心理准备，就像每年8月和9月一样。

items.title: Are you sure that Kimmel clip was real? Late-night AI deepfakes are spreading online
items.summary: While social media is rife with AI celebrity deepfakes, videos featuring late night TV hosts like Jimmy Kimmel and Jon Stewart are are easier to create than other kinds of deepfakes and potentially more disruptive.
items.titleZh: 你确定Kimmel的片段是真的吗？深夜AI deepfakes在网上传播
items.summaryZh: 虽然社交媒体上充斥着人工智能名人的deepfakes，但吉米·坎摩尔和乔恩·斯图尔特等深夜电视主持人的视频比其他类型的deepfake更容易制作，而且可能更具破坏性。

items.title: Why the AI economy is like a bad dating app — drowning in decks, pilot purgatory — and it’s playing out like the dotcom bubble, except worse
items.summary: Amy Webb is a futurist who called the rise of AI — and a U.S./China tech Cold War — years ago. She wishes she were happier with what she's seeing.
items.titleZh: 为什么人工智能经济就像一个糟糕的约会应用程序——淹没在甲板上，飞行员炼狱——它就像互联网泡沫一样，只是更糟
items.summaryZh: 艾米·韦伯（Amy Webb）是一位未来学家，几年前他称人工智能的兴起——以及美中科技冷战。她希望自己能对所看到的更快乐。

items.title: 12 jobs that are set to shrink over the next decade
items.summary: New job projections show which may experience employment declines from 2025 to 2035, whether due to automation or another reason.
items.titleZh: 未来十年将减少的12个工作岗位
items.summaryZh: 新的就业预测显示，无论是由于自动化还是其他原因，从2025年到2035年，哪些国家的就业人数可能会下降。

items.title: AI chatbots may be better than search engines in guarding against foreign propaganda
items.summary: In a test, popular AI chatbots mostly debunked falsehoods spread by other countries and avoided uncritically spreading falsehoods better than search engines. AI summaries above search results fared worse.
items.titleZh: 人工智能聊天机器人在防范外国宣传方面可能比搜索引擎更好
items.summaryZh: 在一项测试中，流行的人工智能聊天机器人大多揭穿了其他国家传播的虚假信息，并且比搜索引擎更好地避免了不加批判地传播虚假信息。搜索结果上方的AI摘要表现较差。
